body: .git/gittoc/.git is a gitfile with an absolute path into .git/worktrees/gittoc, so after moving the host repo every command fails with 'fatal: not a git repository: <old path>'. Tracker._ensure_worktree could detect the broken gitfile and run `git worktree repair` (or re-attach) automatically.
title: tracker worktree breaks when the repository directory is moved
